subject: Leadership Compass: weekly wins, redlines & QBR asks
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: leadership-distro@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-30T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Leadership Compass: weekly wins, redlines & QBR asks

Team —

Quick weekly signal ahead of the QBR prep week. High-level bullets first, then concrete asks (please action the asks you own by EoD Wed):

Wins (last 7 days)
- Hosted API: 10% improvement in 95th percentile token latency after kernel swap on the fs-optim branch (infra + serving). Initial rollout to 40% of traffic looks stable.
- Redwood Optimize pilot: two customers reported a ~22% predicted unit-cost reduction from batching + kv-prefix caching (proof-of-value doc attached).
- Dedicated: first EU Dedicated cluster spun up and validated with internal load tests (throughput within 5% of target).

Risks / Redlines
- Edge case for long-context generation (>= 8k) causing KV-cache thrashing under mixed sizes. If not mitigated, could push up token costs for a handful of enterprise customers.
- QBR decks: still missing confirmed owners for three ask rows in the QBR_ask_tracker.xlsx (attached). Need owners assigned to finalize slides.

Asks (owners, target)
- @laura_bennett: Own the QBR narrative for "Reliability & Degradation". Draft slide + 60s talking points by Tue EOD. (attachment: QBR_ask_tracker.xlsx)
- @marissa_cole: Coordinate with Solutions Eng on the long-context KV-cache mitigation plan; propose a short-term rollback/mitigation and a medium-term fix by Wed COB. Add to tracker.
- @karthik_iyer: Confirm capacity projection for Dedicated EU for next quarter (numbers only) by Wed noon so Finance can bake into forecasts.
- Ops/Infra (jonas_weber): Run a targeted canary for the LRU change that caused the latency spike; capture perf profile and attach snapshot (service-latency-snapshot.png).

External notes: Tom from AcmeHealth flagged a governance question about retention in Private deployments — I’ve looped Sana from MegaHealth in case there’s overlap with compliance asks.

Attachments: QBR_ask_tracker.xlsx, service-latency-snapshot.png
Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QBR-Playbook
HubSpot: HS-12345

Thanks — short replies ok here.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

Rishi
